title: Super Cup ATTP – Summer 2024: final
body_html:
Every tournament in the Super Cup ATTP series impresses — each one grander, more expressive and cooler than the last. Plenty of emotion, experience and satisfaction.

All the finalists were good. Each of them deserved the top step of the podium. But that’s how it goes: the one who best controlled his emotions, who was the more skilful player and, of course, the luckier one, won the big prize — the ATTP Super Cup – Summer 2024.

We congratulate Veniamin Dubrovin on this victory and his well-deserved ATTP Super Cup, and of course we send our sincere congratulations and thanks to prize-winners Danila Titov and Denis Țerna for their fine results at this tournament.

“To say it was extraordinary and thrilling says nothing at all! Every participant created their own scenario, studied their opponent and gained valuable experience. We all witnessed one of the most special national table tennis events of the year” – Rostislav Sobiețki, ATTP President.

It is worth noting that this summer tournament in the Super Cup ATTP cycle aimed to popularise and promote table tennis among all fans of the sport, whatever their age, and among everyone who wants to live a healthy lifestyle. The participants gave their all, with incredible performances and standard of play.

“The tournament was on fire! Every stage was productive and most participants gained good experience”, says Oleg Dobrjinschi, President of TOP CUP.

“It was all super!” summed up the tournament’s chief referee, Alexander Ni.
